description.text: Wenzhou University is the only comprehensive university in southern Zhejiang, northern Fujian and eastern Gandong and a key construction university in Zhejiang Province, located in Wenzhou, a famous historical and cultural city in China and known as the "southeast landscape and water world". The school has two campuses, Chashan and Xueyuan Road, the school covers an area of 1973.43 mu, the school building area is 1.0606 million square meters, the total value of teaching and scientific research equipment is 961 million yuan, the collection is 2.4902 million paper books, 1.8843 million electronic books, and 97 Chinese and foreign language electronic journals and data databases. At present, there are 1353 full-time teachers (880 doctors, accounting for 65.04%; There were 744 people with senior professional titles, accounting for 54.99%. There are 32 national-level talents such as full-time academicians, Changjiang scholars, national outstanding young and middle-aged experts, national "Millions of Talents Project" national candidates, national excellent youth, cultural masters of the Central Propaganda Department and "four batches" talents, and 159 high-level talents above the provincial level. (Data as of May 2022). The college has a first-level master's program in computer science and technology, which is one of the earliest first-level master's degree programs approved by Wenzhou University. In 2021, the computer science discipline entered the top 1% of ESI in the world (ranking fourth in Zhejiang Province). In 2021, he was approved as a master's degree in "electronic information". The college has four undergraduate majors: computer science and technology, network engineering (Zhuogong Chaohao demonstration class), data science and big data technology, and artificial intelligence. Among them, the network engineering major is a national first-class professional construction point, the third domestic university and the first local college to pass the Washington Accord equivalent engineering education certification; The major of data science and big data technology is a first-class professional construction point in the province. At present, there are 106 graduate students and 78 full-time teachers, and the full-time teacher-to-pupil ratio is 1.36:1. There are 38 master's supervisors, and the ratio of graduate supervisors to students is 2.79:1. Among the full-time teachers, there are 18 professors, 30 associate professors and 58 doctors (74.5%). The degree point has various talents such as Distinguished Professor of the Ministry of Education Jiang Scholar Award Program, Hundred Talents Program of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, National Excellent Youth, Provincial Science and Technology Innovation Leading Talents, Provincial Youth Top Talents, Provincial University Innovation Leading Talents, Provincial Famous Teachers, Provincial Young Teachers Funding Program, Provincial "Thousand Talents Program" and other talent teams.

duration.text: The Electronic Science and Technology at Wenzhou University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 200 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3055 USD/per year ￥ 22000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Graduation certificate of highest education level attained*Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.2.An official transcript from the college you have recently attended.* Official transcript should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.3.Two Recommendation letters ( only for Master applicant)4.Certificate of English proficiency test*IELTS or TOEFL will only be required if the applicant is not a native English speaker (A minimum score should be obtained as follows: IELTS 6.0, TOEFL iBT70, or TOEFL paper based 550 ）5.Applicants to Chinese programs must pass HSK grade 5 or above6.A photocopy of your passport.7.Bank statement (normally the balance is enough for your first year tuition fee and accommodation fee )8.No Criminal Report (if necessary)9.Health report ( within the validation period)10.Recommendation letters from two experts (assistant porfessors, associate professors, or professors)11.Self-introduction vedio12.Study Plan of no less than 1000 words.

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport2.University graduate or equivalent to a Chinese University graduate (Master Degree Applicant)3.Be in good health condition and above the age of 18
